<b>Unnamed Skarr</b> is an [[NPCs (Silksong)|NPC]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They gift the [[Curvesickle]] to [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] in [[Far Fields]].

== Background ==
Unnamed Skarr's skin is mottled with grey spots, a trait that it shares with [[Mottled Skarr]] and [[Gurr the Outcast]]. Its Needolin dialogue implies that Skarr with mottled skin are persecuted by other [[Skarr]].<ref>Unnamed Skarr: <i>"Our mark is no curse..."</i></ref>

== In-Game Events ==
Unnamed Skarr can be found in Far Fields after [[Act 3]] begins. They initially hide underground upon being approached, but after hitting all four targets in the room with one throw of the [[Curveclaw]] they reappear. Giving them the Curveclaw causes them to burrow underground, and sitting on a Bench and reentering the room causes the Curvesickle to appear where they had been.

{{TabbedDialogue
| Title1_Event1 = Playing the [[Needolin]]
| Title1_Dialogue1 = [n]For death... I give death... <br>
Our mark is no curse... <br>
We still hear it... <br>
Strength... shall not fade... <br>
}}

== Location ==
Unnamed Skarr can be found in a room above the [[Bellway]] in [[Far Fields]] during [[Act 3]].
